comment: fsd: QA's second pass after the CI rework gave 46 criteria a pass and none a fail. The six it could not settle (the existing trace, record and restart loading tests; the cli integration suite; upgrade leaving run state untouched with real units; an old-wording file starting no round; a story in flight on an old pin finishing its round; a restart from an old branch file) all need a remote or the integration tier, which only CI runs: each has an integration test in the diff, and ready is approved only once CI is green on the final head. The orientations criterion is unchanged from the first human-qa, approved there: every shipped agent step has an orientation, ten of them the owner's own earlier instructions word for word, none a fallback line
